g.title: ServiceSyncWorkflow
g.text: Current quote-based customer and provider journey

g.title: browse
g.text: Search, filter, sort and inspect photos

g.title: atomic
g.text: Claim the open job and accept selected quote
Create booking with agreed quote price
Decline competing pending quotes and requests

g.title: history
g.text: Include agreed price in provider earnings

g.title: rating
g.text: Save review and update provider average

g.title: later
g.text: Skip review or choose Maybe later

g.title: end
g.text: Keep history or hide own record

g.title: note
g.text: - Validation and role / ownership checks apply to protected actions.
- Booking and quote notifications are separate from chat alerts.
- Open jobs can be edited or soft-deleted by their customer.
- Pending direct requests remain supported by the API for older records.
- Reviews are optional; removing history does not require a review.
- Earnings are summaries, not online payments.
